description: A short ranked list of on-sale products in one category for a shopper: optionally the phone platform they use, a budget, and up to three priorities from the uses iDevice's Guides assign (for example sleep, running, battery-life, photos-video). Each product comes with its verdict (buy_now or wait), its fit with the phone given, today's retailer price, a one-line reason and its sources, and the place its Guide gives a named priority. In the list: a verdict of Buy now or Wait, and Works or Works with a limit with the phone given. Order: the verdict, then the fit answer, then where the product's Guide places a named priority among the uses it lists, then price. A priority outside the Guides' uses is refused and the uses are listed. The same list rule as the decision card on idevice.com. No model is involved.

budget_usd.description: A price ceiling in US dollars

owned_platform.description: The phone platform the shopper uses

priorities.description: Up to three uses, e.g. ['sleep','battery-life']. A use iDevice's Guides do not assign is refused, with the list.

name: find_best_device
title: Find the device that fits
